name: code/failing-tests
title: Make failing tests pass
summary: Make failing tests pass: run them, read the first failure, decide whether code or test is wrong, fix, rerun.
when: Use when tests fail and the user wants them passing again.
steps: Call run_command with the project's test command, such as pytest -x, and read the first failure; when none fails, say so and stop.
Call read_file on the test and on the code it calls at the failing line to see what each one expects.
Decide in one sentence whether the code or the test is wrong, and say which before editing anything.
Change the code with apply_patch when the code is wrong, and only the line the failure points at.
Change the test with replace_in_file only when it asserts behaviour that was meant to change, and say why.
Call run_command with the same test command again and read whether that first failure is gone.
Call undo_changes when the fix breaks more tests, then take the other answer from step 3.
Answer with which side was wrong, the fix, and the full test result.
next: The final answer must say which side was wrong, what changed with file and line, and the full test result.
